notes:
修复三处跨机同步缺陷（另一台机器实测报障）：
1) 拉取后插件版本回退：capture 原来只把 link: 依赖归一成 npm 版本，profile/package.json 里已是裸版本号（如 0.4.17）时原样入库；插件自更新（install-restart）也只覆盖插件目录、不回写 profile 依赖版本。现在 capture 一律按本机 node_modules 实际版本归一，post-exit 的 update 模式装完即回写各 profile 的依赖版本，下一次 pull 不会再按旧 lockfile 装回旧版。
2) 「未同步的文件 N 个」下面没有明细：post-exit 的小结只列了六类 notice，漏了 apply 落地自检产生的 landing 类，于是只有 landing 一条时标题有数字、明细为空、只剩「清单文件：…」页脚。已补 landing 分组；面板标题括注也带上「N 项落地自检未通过」。
3) 「落地检查 storages/session_projcache/sessions」常驻且清不掉：原判据用占位符正则匹配 projcache 全文，而这类 json 存的是会话对话内容（用户贴的日志、脚本注释里都带 {{APP_ROOT}} 字样），属误报。现在只认 record.identity.cwd 字段里的占位符。
实测：selftest 402 项全过（X=0/SKIP=5）、clientcheck 全通过、三个 ps1 语法与 BOM 全 OK；命中 0.4.27 已装环境的机器不再出现上述三条。
notesEn:
Three cross-machine sync defects fixed (reported from a second machine):
1) Plugin version rolled back after pull: capture only normalised link: specs to npm versions, so a bare version such as 0.4.17 was committed as-is; the self-update path (install-restart) also only overwrote the plugin directory and never wrote the version back into the profile dependency. capture now always normalises to the actually installed version, and post-exit update mode rewrites every profile dependency right after installing, so the next pull no longer reinstalls the old version from the stale lockfile.
2) "Unsynced files: N" with no detail lines: the post-exit summary only covered six notice kinds and missed the landing kind produced by the apply landing check, so when landing was the only entry the headline had a count, the list was empty, and only the "list file: ..." footer remained. The landing group is now included; the panel headline also appends "N landing check(s) failed".
3) "Landing check: storages/session_projcache/sessions" stuck forever: the predicate matched placeholder tokens anywhere in the projcache JSON, but those files hold conversation transcripts (pasted logs and script comments legitimately contain {{APP_ROOT}}), so it was a false positive. It now only inspects the record.identity.cwd field.
Verified: selftest 402 checks all pass (X=0/SKIP=5), clientcheck green, all three ps1 files parse clean and keep their BOM; machines on 0.4.27 no longer see any of the three.
